invariants: Public sources never receive private trainer, manager, booking-reference or calendar text.
Aircraft position is not flight status, aircraft assignment or available seat inventory.
Historical route, fare and passenger metrics retain period, cohort, scope and denominator.
Evidence snapshot identity and provider observation time are separate from retrieval time.
No relevant record, invalid schema, outside coverage and provider unavailable remain different outcomes.
All screens use the same normalized facts through compatible projections during migration.
Local booking drafts are shared only through explicit reviewed journey attachment.
Only explicit reviewed approval may update calendars, with revision/expiry/idempotency checks.
New sources remain disabled until each use, access, schema, time and production-readiness gate is met.
Commercial offer search remains disabled; no paid service is activated.
Planespotters photos and metadata are excluded from AI/ML datasets, training and evaluation.
Provider failure does not become a normal/clear airport or successful trip conclusion.
